notes: Large-source unit בַּשָּׁנָה → 'yearly' reviewed: preposition, assimilated article and noun are all carried by the single adverb, with no word spent on any one of them, so the three-morpheme fusion stands (rules 30, 40). 'with' reaches the verb's own bare object under rule 44; the second על is silenced by the recasting (rule 40).
